questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer:
Academic Reputation and Quality: I researched the universities and colleges in the destination and assed their academic reputation, rankings, and the quality of education they offer.

Programs and Courses: I wanted to ensure that the destination offered programs and courses that aligned with my academic and career goals.

Language: I wanted to further my italian.

Cost of Living was important to me

Cultural Experience: I greatly considered the cultural diversity and experiences the different destinations offered. Italy seemed like a great fit.
